summary: Reproduced the TP-rank-only metadata protocol in focused tests and changed TransferEngine registration, bootstrap storage, and remote lookup to use SGLang's model-parallel world rank, preventing PP stages with the same TP rank from overwriting each other.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression on the original implementation: 4 failed and 4 passed, demonstrating rejection of world-rank registration and missing producer/consumer world-rank plumbing. Raw output: raw/failing-before.log.

Passing-after coverage of TP1/PP2 stage isolation, a nonzero TP+PP world-rank boundary, ModelRunner rank injection, registration payload identity, remote loader lookup identity, and existing rank/protocol behavior: 42 passed plus 14 subtests. Raw output: raw/final-focused.log.
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, spelling, test-registration, and related pre-commit checks for all changed Python files. Raw output: raw/pre-commit.log.

gpu_execution.evidence: The environment exposes one AMD Instinct MI350X. The issue's TP1/PP2 reproduction requires two concurrent pipeline workers, and the reported Qwen3-8B weights were unavailable. Inventory and rank initialization evidence are retained in raw/environment-and-rank-evidence.log.

remaining_limitations: No full two-GPU TP1/PP2 seed-to-destination TransferEngine run was possible with the assigned single GPU.
The reported Qwen3-8B weights were not available, so model-architecture behavior and semantic output were not validated.
No multi-node or RDMA transport claim is made; the regression validates the actual bootstrap HTTP server and Python producer/consumer control path.
